question: How is the goddess Lakṣmī to be understood in relation to mantra syllables and the mothers?
premises: Lakṣmī is composed of mantra syllables.
Lakṣmī bears the form of the mothers.
These attributes define her ritual identity.
inference: Lakṣmī is to be understood as mantra-syllable-made and bearing the form of the mothers.
plain_english: She is Lakṣmī, made of mantra syllables and bearing the form of the mothers.
